title: v2.0: Snowflake Transport + WebSocket API + Bug Fixes
head: v2.0-snowflake-websocket
body:
## Summary

This PR delivers v2.0 of the Tor Windows AutoInstaller, adding major new features and bug fixes.

### New Features

**WebSocket API Server (TorApiServer.ps1)**
- Real-time monitoring and control of Tor via WebSocket at `ws://127.0.0.1:9052/ws`
- REST endpoint at `GET /api/status`
- Commands: status, restart, newnym, circuit, log
- Periodic status push to all connected clients
- Runs as TorApiService via NSSM

**Snowflake Pluggable Transport Support**
- New `snowflake-client.exe` support alongside existing `lyrebird.exe`
- Sample config: `bridges.d/snowflake-bridges.conf.sample`
- Transport-aware watchdog with priority: obfs4 → webtunnel → snowflake

**Multi-Transport Watchdog**
- Detects and activates any supported transport automatically
- Transport-aware state tracking

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed hardcoded absolute paths in `torrc` (now relative for portability)
- Fixed Watchdog-TorAutoBridge.ps1 log rotation handling (offset reset on shrink)
- Fixed PT detection: only one PT required (was requiring both lyrebird.exe and snowflake-client.exe)
- Fixed uninstall to also remove TorApiService
- Fixed CI workflow: pinned to actions/checkout@v4 (v7 may not exist)

### Files Changed
- `TorApiServer.ps1` — New WebSocket API server
- `Setup-TorService.ps1` — Snowflake + API server support
- `Watchdog-TorAutoBridge.ps1` — Multi-transport + log rotation fixes
- `Tor-Installer.iss` — v2.0 packaging with new files
- `Source/torrc` — Relative paths + ControlPort
- `Source/bridges.d/snowflake-bridges.conf.sample` — Snowflake example
- `PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1` — Added exception for API server
- `README.md` — Updated docs with v2.0 features
- `CHANGELOG.md` — 2.0.0 entry
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — Updated architecture docs
- `bridges.d/README.txt` — Multi-transport docs

### Testing
- All PowerShell scripts pass PSScriptAnalyzer with the repo settings file
- WebSocket API tested locally
- Bridge activation logic verified
